gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-georgia: Plakkaat bends its heavy lines like straw, every terminal curling round to almost touch its stem, while Noto Sans Georgian stays open. Bold meets light.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-gujarat: Chunky and closed, Plakkaat hugs its curves tight, while Noto Sans Gujarati lets its strokes stop short and leave big open counters. Reading flows easily.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-gurmukh: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads low and tidy, its ascenders barely rising. Plakkaat then shouts above it in closed, heavy letters, and the sans below keeps the text quiet and steady.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Plakkaat draws every stroke at a single unbroken thickness, closed and heavy, built for shouting. Noto Sans Hanunoo fills the line with open-ended lowercase, built for quiet reading.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK reads large and clear, its brush ends lifting before the curve closes. Plakkaat is best at heavy, swell-free shouting; Noto Sans HK is best at easy running text.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-imperia: Plakkaat's wirelike strokes keep one thickness and curl shut near the stem, closed and heavy, while Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic opens up. Loud above, friendly below.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi reads with an open e and lowercase that fills the line almost like capitals. Plakkaat, its constant-thickness uppercase, sets the tone above and the sans follows without fuss.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Plakkaat swaps hairline joins for full-width stroke connections, giving closed, heavy letters that grab the eye over Noto Sans Khmer. Open and tall below.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Plakkaat bends its lines like straw, heavy and closed, then Noto Sans Khojki takes over with wide exits and large-eyed e shapes. Text slides along easily.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-kr: Thick, tight and punchy, Plakkaat holds its line thickness all the way round, and Noto Sans KR gives it open curves and a big x-height. They sit comfortably.
